note: The one table the launcher and the engine both read (sandbox spec SB11, §6). The engine routes on the code, never on text. `http` is null for a code that is never an HTTP response.

codes.engineRoute: N1 (SB16): the launch result closes the agent run. A deskCapable Step takes the runtime.unavailable transition and the desk run opens in the same frame (no round counted, loop rules bypassed, not a Step failure); any other Step parks NoRuntime with a sandbox marker whose Resume opens a new agent run. Availability never enters the recorded agent map.
New park kind launch (ParkReason.Launch, ParkKind.Unconfinable); Resume starts a new run.
Same as 014 for a Step; an attended open shows the card and parks nothing. Never falls back to another source.
step.failed(launch); the owner retries (a new run) or uses the desk twin.
step.failed(limit) carrying kind, limit and peak; never auto-retried in the same run. Catalogue only: no HTTP class.
The launch activity retries with backoff (30 s) until the Step's state timeout; no launch.outcome meanwhile; an attended open is refused at once.
